title: Craw public page scrape
description: Fetch explicit public http(s) URLs and return one PageRecord per page.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Public http or https pages. Each entry is fetched with the base HTTP template.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Maximum pages to fetch. The template ceiling is 20.

maxRecords.title: Max records
maxRecords.description: Maximum PageRecord rows to save. The template ceiling is 50.

maxTotalChargeUsd.title: Max total charge (USD)
maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Spend cap recorded for this run and required by the optional apify-client delegate. The template Actor does not call other Actors. Also set the same cap on the Apify run.
